data_partition.selection_rule: formal blocks 0-4 fit segment runtimes; blocks 5-9 are excluded from fitting and reserved for the simulator fidelity acceptance audit

sampling: sample with replacement from the matching line/segment/service-hour empirical distribution; fall back to all periods for sparse or missing hours
semantics: for each identified SUMO bus, empirical service-completion time at station k+1 minus service-completion time at station k and minus the k+1 base passenger-exchange dwell; source actions are exact zero hold
simulator_fixed_transition_overhead_sema: the low-fidelity one-second state machine consumes one action tick, one departure tick, and one arrival-detection tick outside its calibrated travel-step counter
